description: This is a Java source file defining a helper class Log that provides static methods to facilitate logging by abstracting and chaining LogNode instances and wrapping around Android's native Log utility.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's Log utility, providing static methods to log messages at various levels and manage LogNode chaining.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the logging chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log data will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Sends log data to the current LogNode for output, considering priority, tag, message, and throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE priority.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG priority.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO priority.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN priority.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR priority.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT priority.
